audit.root_cause: With the default judge settings, the env reads Prime credentials from ~/.prime/config.json. That file is written by `prime login`, which a real `prime env install` user has normally already run; our VM has no Prime credentials.
audit.evidence: if_summarize_judge.py:71 `open(os.path.expanduser("~/.prime/config.json"))` called at :198 when judge_url is unset; load.log: `No such file or directory: '/root/.prime/config.json'`.
audit.irl_fix: (Nice-to-have) Fall back to the PRIME_API_KEY env var and give a clear error suggesting `prime login` or `-a '{"judge_url": ...}'`.
